preregistered.benchmark: savings rate paid each day (term_carry.load_navs savings_path); constant 3.80% beside it

costs.half_spread: bucket p75 of 2026-10-11 book tickers by 24 h quote volume, floored at half a tick

preregistered.pass_rule: in_sample_positive and OOS HAC t > 2 and chosen in BH survivors and OOS excess > 0 at $3M
preregistered.protocol: backtest.choose_then_test on daily excess, choose on the first half (Sharpe), test once on the second; BH q=0.10 on full-sample Newey-West p; deflated Sharpe with 32 trials
preregistered.rank: trailing-30d floor share (desc), then trailing-30d funding APR (desc), then spot 30d median quote volume (desc)
preregistered.universe_main: Binance USD-M coin perps whose spot coin is on the 2026-10-11 classic portfolio-margin list (c > 0), K from that ratio
preregistered.universe_robustness: every Binance USD-M coin perp with a same-venue spot market (delisted included), K at an assumed ratio (median c of the main universe)

protocol_amendments.what: BH survivors use one-sided p-values (mean daily excess > 0, full-sample Newey-West); backtest.choose_then_test's two-sided list is kept beside it as bh_survivors_full_sample_two_sided (under two-sided p a significant loser also survives)
Bybit added as a second venue with the same grid and protocol (its own choose-then-test)
